entities.name: Bratislav Ristić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bratislav Ristić is a Yugoslav boxer. He competed in the men's featherweight event at the 1976 Summer Olympics. At the 1976 Summer Olympics, he defeated Mohamed Younes Naguib and Gustavo de la Cruz, before losing to Leszek Kosedowski.
